cards.internship_rate: 98.9% of internship-seeking 18-month students (graduating Feb 2026) received a summer 2025 internship offer; 97.9% accepted (n seeking ≈94 of 103 enrolled in that format).
cards.full_time_placement: 97.1% of Class of 2025 seekers received an offer within 6 months; 94.2% accepted within 6 months (reporting rate 100%; sought employment 104/117 = 88.9%).
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Official MIT Sloan CDO 2025 MFin Employment Report (Feb 2025 18-month + May 2025 12-month). Mean base $122,858; median base $125,000; mean signing bonus $29,183; median signing $25,000. Nearly 85% accepted Finance industry roles; >5% Technology/AI. Functions: Quant Research/Data Science 26.8%, IBD/Transactions Advisory 19.6%, Quant Trading Research/Sales 17.5%. Class profile International 89%.
notable_employers: Morgan Stanley (8 FT hires Class of 2025 highlight)
cards.notable_employers_notes: Highlight multi-hire list from official 2025 report; full employer roster on report p.8 includes AQR, Brevan Howard, Capula, Citi, DRW, Optiver, Point72, UBS, Verition, etc.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Very high. Official multi-hire bulge/elite quant: MS, JPM, GS, Squarepoint, QRT, Trexquant, Citadel*, BlackRock*, Optiver*. IBD + quant research/trading dominate functions.
sample_alumni_paths: Quantitative Research / Data Science associate roles
Private Equity / Venture Capital (~7.2% of Class of 2025 functions)
cards.referral_network_notes: Sloan CDO + MFin alumni; Action Learning Labs; dense NYC/HK/London placements. 47.2% of Feb 2025 graduates who accepted FT rejoined summer internship employer. Formal cold-outreach ease: unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: Highly selective (QuantNet cites ~8.3% acceptance for recent cycle — secondary). International-heavy cohort (~89%). Strong brand does not remove interview bars for quant/IB.
cards.intl_student_notes: STEM-designated MFin historically; Class of 2025 profile 89% international / 38 countries. Confirm current STEM CIP with school for Fall 2027 OPT planning.
